jobDescription.name: Your mission
jobDescription.value:
At deskbird, you’re not joining a volume-driven outbound machine, you’re stepping into a company where your impact is visible from day one, your progression is tied to performance (not tenure), and your work directly shapes how we scale across Europe.

You’ll be at the heart of our expansion strategy into the UK and Irish market, partnering closely with Demand Generation and Sales to build pipeline, shape regional growth initiatives, and directly influence our success in the market.

We’re a leading workplace management platform, backed by $23M Series B funding and trusted by global brands. But what makes us different is how we operate: founder-led, fast-moving, and deeply focused on building a high-performance culture without the corporate politics.

If you’re looking for a role where you can accelerate, not just “gain experience”, this is it.

This is a hybrid role based out of our London hub.

jobDescription.name: In this role you will
jobDescription.value:
• Execute outbound strategies across the UKI market (calls, email, LinkedIn)
  • Identify and break into high-value accounts with tailored, relevant messaging
  • Create pipeline that converts, not just volume that looks good on dashboards
  • Partner closely with AEs on account strategy to win deals, not just pass leads
  • Experiment constantly: test messaging, channels, and approaches to improve performance
  • Contribute to shaping how outbound is done at deskbird as we scale

jobDescription.name: What you need to be successful
jobDescription.value:
One year of previous sales experience would be ideal. 
However, we care far more about how you think and operate than how many years you’ve done the job.
  • You’re proactive by nature, you don’t wait for leads, you create opportunities
  • You’re competitive and driven
  • You’re confident speaking to senior stakeholders
  • You’re curious, you want to understand industries, personas, and what actually resonates
  • You take ownership and move fast
  • You’re motivated by growth, this role is a stepping stone, not the destination
Language requirements: Native British English (additional languages are a bonus)

jobDescription.name: What’s in it for you?
jobDescription.value:
• Generous annual leave: Unlimited PTO
  • Annual company summit: Meet the whole team at our yearly summit in inspiring locations across Europe.
  • Team “Bursts”: Opportunities to collaborate with your team in person.
  • Home office support: Financial contribution to set up a comfortable, productive home office.
  • Learning & development: Annual budget for coaching, certifications, and conferences.
  • Co-working allowance: Budget to work from co-working spaces if there are no deskbird hubs close by.

jobDescription.name: Your mission
jobDescription.value:
deskbird is one of Europe's fastest-growing workplace-management platforms – a SaaS success story serving hundreds of enterprise customers and building the operating system for the workplace of the future, well past €10M ARR and scaling with an efficiency-driven playbook. In 2025 we closed a funding round led by Octopus Ventures, with co-investments from NEVA SGR (Intesa Sanpaolo Bank) and AVP, and participation from Alstin Capital, session, and Portfolion.


We're hiring a Chief Financial Officer (all genders) to be a true co-pilot to the management team. This is not just a back-office finance role. You will sit in board meetings from day one, own the equity story, lead our future financing rounds and capital markets strategy, and run an AI-first operations function that becomes a case study in how lean a modern finance organization can be.


You'll join a small, talented, highly ambitious executive team – and the equity package is designed so that when we win, you win meaningfully.


If you are passionate about creating enterprise value, scaling finance organizations, and owning the story you used to analyze – this is that seat.

jobDescription.name: In this role you will
jobDescription.value:
1. The equity story and funding readiness. You will keep deskbird in the best possible shape for whatever comes next - future financing rounds, strategic options, and long-term value creation. Narrative, metrics, data room, diligence readiness: always current, always credible. When we choose to run a process, you will lead it, working directly with the founders and board.

  2. The path to profitability. You’ll own the plan that takes us to sustainable positive cash flows profitability without sacrificing growth: driver-based planning, disciplined capital allocation, and a sharp view on where every franc and euro works hardest.

  3. An AI-first finance & operations function. We want a hands-on operator on the edge of AI development who automates before hiring, works in the models and tools personally, and proves that a lean, AI-augmented team can outperform a traditional org several times its size. We don’t want a CFO who builds a 20-person department.

  4. Commercial intelligence for GTM and Product. You’ll drive the insights that tell us where to invest: which segments, motions, and product bets deliver the strongest combined growth and efficiency profile. Finance at deskbird is a value driver in pricing, packaging, NRR economics, and unit-economics decisions - not just a scorekeeper.

  5. International structure and tax efficiency. You’ll own our multi-entity group structure across Europe, introduce transfer pricing, and ensure we operate in a tax-efficient, fully compliant setup as we scale internationally.

  6. The cap table and investor-grade financials. You’ll keep our cap table and VSOP clean, well-modeled, and always ready for the next financing round, and bring our accounting to the  standard any institutional investor expects - SaaS revenue recognition (local GAAP) done right, smooth statutory audits, and, where a future process demands it, conversion to the relevant GAAP.

  7. Board and investor relations. You’ll run the reporting rhythm, build trust with our existing investors, and represent deskbird credibly to future ones - from day one, alongside the founders.

  8. Cash, risk, and the operational backbone. Treasury, FX, and runway discipline, scenario planning, audit readiness, and oversight of legal, procurement, and insurance.

jobDescription.name: What you need to be successful
jobDescription.value:
Must-haves
  • A transaction-shaped career: ideally PE, M&A or investment banking, followed by operating experience in a scaling company - you’ve seen deals from the inside and know what investors actually sign up for. (Exceptional candidates from transaction advisory (e.g. Big4) or top-tier strategy consulting with strong deal exposure will also be considered.)
  • Deep fluency in finance processes and B2B SaaS mechanics: ARR/NRR, cohort economics, CAC payback, Rule of 40, the ARR-to-cash bridge.
  • Experience at our scale and complexity (>€10M ARR, ~100+ employees) - and ideally, you’ve already seen what comes next (>€25M ARR), so you know what to build now and what to deliberately skip.
  • Fundraising and/or liquidity event exposure, ideally where the story was efficient, profitable growth rather than growth at all costs.
  • A builder’s ego profile: you measure yourself by enterprise value created per person on your team, not by headcount or budget owned. You’re hands-on and want to stay that way.
  • Genuine excitement about AI-native ways of working - you’re already using these tools daily and want to push further.
  • Based in or willing to work from one of our hubs - Zurich, Berlin, Munich, or London (remote within Europe is possible for an outstanding candidate, but hub-based is our strong preference given the closeness to founders and board). Full working proficiency in English; German is strongly preferred.
Nice to have
  • Experience owning or partnering closely with People & Culture.
  • Multi-entity European operations: Swiss/EU accounting, VAT, transfer pricing, cross-border payroll.
  • Venture debt, structured financing, or buy-side M&A experience.

jobDescription.name: What’s in it for you?
jobDescription.value:
• A rare stage - big enough to matter (>€10M ARR, enterprise customers, proven playbook), small enough that your fingerprints will be on everything.
  • Meaningful equity upside - a package built for a founder-like profile in a capital-efficient business, where the value you help create is value you share in.
  • A real seat at the table - board meetings from day one, direct partnership with the founders, and full ownership of your domain.
  • An AI-first culture - the freedom (and expectation) to build the most modern finance function in European SaaS.
  • A high-talent, low-ego executive team that moves fast and debates openly.

jobDescription.name: Your mission
jobDescription.value:
As part of deskbird, a fast-growing workplace tech company backed by a $23M Series B and trusted by leading global brands, you’ll work alongside an ambitious, high-performing teams with a proven product and a clear strategy.

We are building a revenue-driven GTM organization where partnerships are a core growth channel, not a side initiative.


The Director of Partnerships will own the end-to-end partner strategy, including:
  • Acquisition of high-value strategic partners
  • Growth and monetization of existing partners
  • Using partnerships as a key lever for international expansion

This role is responsible for turning partnerships into a predictable, scalable source of pipeline and ARR.

jobDescription.name: In this role you will
jobDescription.value:
1. Own Global Partner Strategy & Revenue Contribution
  • Define and execute the global partnerships strategy aligned with company revenue goals.
  • Build partnerships into a meaningful, measurable revenue channel
  • Define: Target partner types (e.g. resellers, channel, strategic, tech, ecosystem), revenue contribution targets & market-specific partnership strategies.
  • Ensure partnerships are not measured by volume, but by: Pipeline generated, revenue closed & long-term partner value.

2. Acquire High-Impact Strategic Partners
  • Identify and prioritize partners that: Provide access to target ICPs, accelerate entry into key markets & complement our product and positioning.
  • Lead end-to-end partner acquisition: Sourcing, negotiation, structuring agreements & onboarding. 
  • Focus on quality over quantity: Fewer, high-performing partners & clear monetization potential from day one. 

3. Drive Partner Growth & Monetization
  • Own ongoing performance and growth of existing partners.
  • Ensure partners: Actively generate pipeline, are enabled to sell effectively & are integrated into GTM motion.
  • Build structured partner growth programs: Joint GTM initiative, co-marketing campaigns, account mapping and co-selling & performance tracking and reviews.
  • Move the organization from: “We have partners” → “Partners generate meaningful ARR”

4. Use Partnerships as a Market Expansion Lever
  • Leverage partnerships to: Enter new geographic markets (especially where direct presence is limited) & accelerate market penetration in strategic regions. 
  • Identify partners with: Strong local presence, established customer relationships & distribution or influence in key markets.
  • Build region-specific partner strategies aligned with POD structure.

5. Partner Closely with Demand Gen & Sales
  • Work with Demand Gen to: Build co-marketing campaigns, activate partner-driven pipeline & support regional GTM initiatives. 
  • Align with Sales to: Enable co-selling, support strategic deals & integrate partners into account strategies.

6. Partner Enablement & Program Development
  • Define and build: Partner onboarding processes, enablement materials (with PMM and GTM Ops), incentive structures & partner tiers and programs.
  • Ensure partners: Understand our value proposition, can position and sell effectively & are motivated to prioritize our solution.

7. Partner Performance Tracking & Accountability
  • Define and track: Pipeline generated by partners, revenue contribution, partner activation rates & time-to-first-deal.
  • Partner with GTM Ops to: Ensure visibility into partner-sourced and influenced revenue & build clear reporting and attribution.
  • Regularly evaluate: Which partners to scale, which partners to fix & which partners to exit.

jobDescription.name: What you need to be successful
jobDescription.value:
• 8–12+ years in partnerships, business development, or channel roles in B2B SaaS
  • Proven track record of: Building and scaling partnership programs & driving measurable revenue through partners.
  • Experience in: Partner acquisition and negotiation, partner growth and monetization & international or multi-region partnerships.
  • Strong commercial mindset, thinks in pipeline and revenue, not relationships.
  • Strategic thinker, understands how partnerships fit into GTM.
  • Strong operator, can build structure, process, and programs.
  • Excellent communicator and negotiator.
  • Based in Europe.

Bonus
  • Fluent or Native in German.
  • Experience in European and/or US markets.
  • Experience in both early-stage and scaling environments.
  • Familiarity with SaaS partner ecosystems (resellers, integrators, tech partners).

jobDescription.name: What’s in it for you?
jobDescription.value:
• Grow fast: Join Europe’s leading workplace management software company and accelerate your career development.
  • Annual company summit: Meet the whole team at our yearly summit in inspiring locations across Europe (check out the video from our last summit).
  • Team “Bursts”: Unlimited opportunities to collaborate with your team in person.
  • Home office support: Financial contribution to set up a comfortable, productive home office.
  • Learning & development: Annual budget for coaching, certifications, and conferences.
  • Hub visit: Yearly sponsored trip to one of our hubs.
  • Generous annual leave: Plenty of time off to recharge.
  • Joy budget: Annual budget to spend on activities that spark joy, connection, and shared energy.
